Property.Name: ue_IsSetup
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction WHERE EventAction.EventHandlerRowPointer = RowPointer AND EventAction.ActionType = 21 AND EventAction.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND EventAction.Parameters = 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + IDOCollections + '")' ) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlersAreSetup
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoPostItemInsert' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters = 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '")' ) = 1) AND (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoPostItemUpdate' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters = 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '")' ) = 1) AND (( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventAction as action JOIN dbo.EventHandler as handler ON handler.RowPointer = action.EventHandlerRowPointer WHERE handler.EventName = 'IdoOnItemDelete' AND handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName AND action.ActionType = 21 AND action.Parameters = 'IDO("ue_AIR_IDOReplicationRules") METHOD("ReplicateRecordToExternalSystems") PARMS(-1, SUBSTITUTE("RowPointer = ''{0}''", P("RowPointer")), "' + CollectionName + '")' ) = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlerSetupWasAttempted
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.EventHandler as handler WHERE handler.Description = 'ue_AIR_ReplicationTrigger' AND handler.AppliesToObjects = CollectionName ) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

Property.Name: ue_EventHandlersStatus
Property.Expression: CASE WHEN ( ue_EventHandlerSetupWasAttempted = 0 ) THEN 'Not Setup' WHEN ( ue_EventHandlersAreSetup = 1 ) THEN 'Setup' ELSE 'Broken' END

Property.Name: JSON
Property.Expression: CONCAT( '{ "OutputFieldName": "' + Name + '", "Sources": [', ISNULL( ( SELECT STRING_AGG( CASE WHEN ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.type = 'IdoProperty' THEN '"P(' + ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.value + ')"' ELSE '"' + ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.value + '"' END, ', ' ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.source_seq ASC) FROM dbo.ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource WHERE ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.rule_num = RuleNum and ue_AIR_idorepl_mapfieldsource.field_seq = FieldSeq ), '' ), '] }' )

PropertyAttributes.InlineList: ENTRIES(DateTimeToDate\DateTime to Date,DecimalToInteger\Decimal to Integer,DecimalToUSDString\Decimal to USD String,ByteToBoolean\Checkbox (Byte) to Boolean,ByteToTrueFalseString\Checkbox (Byte) to True/False String,ByteToYesNoString\Checkbox (Byte) to Yes/No String) DISPLAY(2) VALUE(1)
